items.stem: If $2x - 5 = 3$, what is the value of $x$?
items.explanation: Add $5$ to both sides: $2x = 8$. Divide both sides by $2$ to get $x = 4$.
items.skill_note: One inverse operation at a time; the trap is changing the sign of the constant when it crosses the equals sign.
items.check: Substituted back: $2(4) - 5 = 3$, matching the right-hand side.

divided total revenue by the adult price only
rounded an elimination step instead of finishing it
correct
items.explanation: Let $a$ be adult tickets. Then $15a + 7(41 - a) = 471$, which simplifies to $8a = 184$. So $a = 23$.

items.stem: A hiking group can carry at most $111$ pounds of gear. Each tent weighs $13$ pounds and each food crate weighs $9$ pounds. If the group brings $2$ tents, what is the greatest number of food crates they can carry?

items.check: Checked $15 + 15(6) = 105 \le 108$, while one more crate would need $111 > 108$.

items.stem: The quantity $y$ is directly proportional to $x$. When $x = 11$, $y = 66$. What is the value of $y$ when $x = 8$?
choice_notes: assumed $y$ does not change
correct

items.skill_note: Find the constant of proportionality first; adding the change in $x$ ignores the rate.
